purpose: Curated always-known skills and wrappers for the Universal AI setup. This file is an index only; full skill bodies stay in the canonical skills corpus and are loaded on demand.

wrapperSkills.name: universal-ai-skills
wrapperSkills.description: Tells host AIs to call skill-router preflight/search/skill instead of copying the corpus.

wrapperSkills.name: universal-ai-setup
wrapperSkills.description: Maintains this repository as the AI setup hub.

wrapperSkills.name: universal-ai-config
wrapperSkills.description: Audits and repairs cross-agent router-first configuration.

securityRules: Do not copy full skill bodies into local AI roots.
Do not commit secrets, API keys, OAuth session files, logs, or generated state.
Keep hosted-agent adapters compact and instruction-only unless an explicit MCP/API bridge is configured.
Run skill-router skills validate-manifest after corpus changes.
